Box drawing example:
┌─────────────┐
│ status: ok  │
├─────────────┤
│ result ✓    │
└─────────────┘

Arrows and math: result → 42, count ≥ 0, diff ≠ 0
Diagonal arrows: ↗ increase, ↘ decrease, ↖ back, ↙ down-left
Bidirectional: ↔ horizontal, ↕ vertical
Temperature: 100°C, size ±5%, scale ×2
Dashes: range 1–10, note — see below
Ellipsis: loading…
Spinner frames: ⠋⠙⠹⠸⠼⠴⠦⠧⠇⠏
Controls: ▶ play, ⏸ pause, ↺ retry, ↻ refresh
Status: ○ pending, ● active, ⚠ warning
